payloads.title: Blue Lions Formation
payloads.prompt:
Byleth calmly gestures students into position. Dimitri listens near the center, Dedue holds the defensive side, Felix looks impatient, Sylvain stays loose, Ashe watches for ranged instructions, Annette and Mercedes stay together, Ingrid checks the flank. Keep motion small and tactical.

Camera: medium-wide orbit or subtle push. Identity locks: Dimitri is a blond 17-year-old student prince in Blue Lions academy uniform, not king or armor. Dedue is tall dark-skinned with short white hair and shield/guard posture. Felix is dark-blue-haired tied-back duelist in black vest with white sleeves, stern and impatient. Sylvain has tousled red-orange hair and relaxed spear-student posture. Ashe has pale ash-gray hair, blue hooded layer, and bow. Annette is petite with peach-orange hair, straight bangs, curled side pigtails, nervous mage posture. Mercedes has blonde long side ponytail, white cravat, cream shawl trim, gentle healer presence, not matronly. Ingrid is blonde disciplined lance student with blue tights, checking the flank. Use formation roles and silhouettes rather than inventing generic uniformed students.
